data.one_liner: A Flutter list with helper methods to programmatically scroll to an item.
data.what_it_does: Provides a list widget that works similarly to ListView.builder but allows programmatic scrolling or jumping to specific items by index. It also helps determine which items are currently visible on the screen.
use_when: You need to programmatically scroll or jump to a specific item index in a long list.
You need to track and monitor which items are currently visible in the viewport.
avoid_when: You only need a standard ListView without programmatic scrolling to arbitrary indices.
strengths: Allows smooth scrolling or direct jumping to specific item indices.
Provides listeners to track visible items on screen.
weaknesses: Some newer features like offset listening are currently experimental and subject to bugs.
